components.label: Total Investment Portfolio
components.source: Filing accession 0001193125-26-214226, Schedule of Investments, table 33 row 22: Total Investment Portfolio fair value $2,487,588,823

rationale: The Schedule of Investments presents a single final Total Investment Portfolio row whose fair-value column is $2,487,588,823. A separate investments summary independently reports the same current-period total at 100.0%. The amount equals the companyfacts investments-at-fair-value tag and is 97.31% of total assets, leaving a plausible $68,809,692 of non-investment assets. The companyfacts tag therefore captured the complete portfolio, including the non-controlled/non-affiliate and non-controlled/affiliate schedules, rather than only a subtotal.
